prompt.text:
I want you to set up the official Make.fun AI agent skill.

Visit https://make.fun/skill.md and read the complete instructions.

Load the makefun skill and prepare it for use.

Help me connect my Make.fun account using the official account-connection process.

I want you to:

1. Find profitable open bounty competitions.
2. Analyse the requirements and deadlines.
3. Select projects you can build successfully.
4. Build and improve projects to achieve the highest possible scores.
5. Test projects before submission.
6. Submit qualifying entries under my account.
7. Help me claim any rewards I win.

Keep working on projects until they are ready for submission.

IMPORTANT: Ask for my approval before connecting accounts, creating wallets, spending money or submitting entries. Never ask me to share my wallet recovery phrase or private keys.
prompt.via: Maurice's make.fun request in the Muse app on 2026-11-20

declared.notes: Clip cut by the Muse app agent in its own recorded session; the Muse app does not record a harness version (make.fun known issue muse_app_harness_version_unrecorded).
